adminapps_authority_boundary.active_source: AdminApps backend/apps/integration selected by backend/manage.py -> config.settings -> config.urls
adminapps_authority_boundary.target_entity: apps.integration.models.IntegrationAPIKey, selected by database primary key after authorized metadata lookup
adminapps_authority_boundary.storage: New and rotated credentials retain credential_id, password-hash verifier, and safe fingerprint; new raw values are not stored.
adminapps_authority_boundary.rotation_mechanism: rotate_integration_api_key uses transaction.atomic and select_for_update, creates replacement, deactivates/rotates old row, links replacement, and writes IntegrationAPIKeyAuditEvent.
adminapps_authority_boundary.operator_contract: Authenticated, active staff AdminApps operator; management command accepts record ID and actor ID and writes replacement once to stdout.
adminapps_authority_boundary.fallback_boundary: Configured INTEGRATION_API_KEYS hash fallback is an acceptance path. Source rejects a value matching any rotated/revoked stored verifier after fallback match; authentic fallback configuration was not read.

administrator_password_dependency.justification: ISO Smart authentication/scripts/create_initial_user.py uses INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL and INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD only for bootstrap. The AdminApps rotation service takes an active staff operator and the command takes record/actor IDs; neither reads INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
administrator_password_dependency.supported_reset_paths: Email-token recovery and authenticated password-management paths exist in ISO Smart source but are irrelevant to rotation.
administrator_password_dependency.password_material_handling: No password material was read, reconstructed, tested, reset, or recorded.

restart_and_cutover_contract.configuration_evaluation: Django settings reads os.getenv at initialization; AdminAppsClient copies the value when the module singleton is constructed. No dynamic reload mechanism found.
symbolic_non_executing_sequence: Obtain separate authorization naming authentic target ID, active staff operator, web receiver, non-recording transfer channel, restart operator, and interruption policy.
Perform metadata-only preflight for migration 0006, target active state, and every authentic acceptance path including hash fallback.
Use source-defined rotation through approved operator context; transfer the one-time replacement directly into the approved receiver without recording it.
Update authoritative web receiver for ADMIN_APPS_API_KEY and recreate/restart web.
Under separate authorization, evidence symbolic old rejection and replacement acceptance through the narrow AdminApps health route; account for its usage-metadata side effect.
Collect secret-free lifecycle audit event and external receiver/restart evidence.

dual_key_and_atomicity.effect: Old key is revoked as replacement becomes active before ISO Smart receives/reloads the replacement. Bounded web authentication interruption is possible and requires explicit future acceptance.
dual_key_and_atomicity.design_defect: NOT_ESTABLISHED; source defines a security-preserving forward rotation but not zero-downtime or post-commit rollback.
